svg.aria-label: Two views of the same analytical teaching field. The native VTK rendering locates the orange section at z₀=0.5 mm inside a transparent ellipsoid. The right panel slices the original volume and overlays the mesh intersection and analytical boundary in physical coordinates. The color scale encodes dimensionless q; transparency affects visibility, while geometry determines lengths and areas.
